title: ATS Corpus Split V1
description: A generated split assignment plus the leakage dimensions it grouped on. A random sentence split is nonconforming (spec Section 17.7), so the generator records the grouping key of every example and refuses when a key is unavailable. A group is the connected component over the closure dimensions (lineage, exact content, near duplication); repository, template, author, domain, and model family constrain where whole groups are placed and never divide one.

seed.description: Assignment is a deterministic function of (seed, group key); no RNG state is carried.

balance_on.description: Dimensions whose every value SHOULD appear in each partition in proportion to that partition's target_fraction. A balance target is the lowest priority the generator knows about and is never satisfied by dividing a group: when a group's own size makes it unreachable the check is UNMET with the group named. A dimension absent here produces no balance entry at all, because an undeclared target is not a target.

balance_tolerance.description: How far a value's observed share of a partition may sit from that partition's target_fraction before a declared balance target is reported unmet. Repository policy, not an ATS-1 threshold.

grouping_dimensions.description: The required set: a dimension named here MUST have a value on every assigned example, and an example missing one goes to unassignable rather than into a partition.

closure_dimensions.description: The closure dimensions that actually joined this group's members, so a lower-priority target reported UNMET can name what protects the group that blocks it. Empty for a group of one example, which is joined by nothing.

closure_priority.description: The highest priority (numerically lowest) among closure_dimensions. Absent exactly when closure_dimensions is empty.

placement_block.description: The group key whose assignment this group inherited, when a declared constraint co-placed it with other groups. Absent when the group was placed on its own key.

status.description: FAIL is leakage: a value of this dimension appears in more than one partition. UNMET is not leakage — a declared target could not be met without dividing a higher-priority group, and blocked_by names the groups that hold.

kind.description: What the entry verifies: that a closure group did not span partitions, that a declared disjointness holds, or that a declared balance target was met.

priority.description: The dimension's rank in the split's priority order, 1 highest. A lower-priority target is never met by breaking a group formed at a higher one.

blocked_by.description: The higher-priority groups that make this target unreachable. Present only when status is UNMET and group integrity is the reason.

unassignable.description: Examples the generator refused to assign because a required grouping key was unavailable.

dimension.description: The fourteen leakage dimensions. The first eleven are the eight ATS-1 Section 17.7 names plus source_mutation_pair, copied_text_cluster, and common_ancestor_document; content_hash, normalized_content_hash, and explicit_derivation are further repository-policy additions, required because the Stage 1 census found byte-identical documents in three separate repositories, which repository grouping alone splits.
